content: The Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī preserves two letters from Jamāl al-Dīn Muḥammad, Ibn Turka's son, to officials (Amīr Muḥammad Shāh, governor of Isfahan, and the bureaucrat Shams al-Dīn Muḥammad Ṭāhir): he says he was sent from Herat to Shiraz to study and fears that if he returned to Herat he would never finish his studies, because of his connections and duties in the capital.
